relationships.subject: Acute postoperative pain
relationships.evidence_quote: the levels of TNF-α in plasma, hippocampus and mPFC in group S were significantly higher than in group C (P < 0.05), while the level of TNF-α in group S + M was obviously lower than that in group S(P < 0.05)

relationships.subject: Morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: the increase of TNF-α in the S group was inhibited in the S + M group

relationships.subject: Acute postoperative pain
relationships.evidence_quote: acute postoperative pain was significantly associated with the activation of microglia cells in the hippocampus and mPFC, while sufficient morphine analgesia inhibited the activation of microglia cells

relationships.subject: Acute postoperative pain
relationships.evidence_quote: increased c-Fos expression in CA1 and mPFC was significantly correlated with acute postoperative pain

key_findings: Acute postoperative pain in aged rats impaired spatial memory and raised TNF-alpha in plasma, hippocampus and mPFC
Morphine analgesia reduced TNF-alpha, microglial activation, c-Fos and memory impairment
